div.head: A database of early English lawcodes
div.p: The eLiebermann Lawcodes Database brings together and makes searchable the law codes of early England. The core of the database consists of the Old English or Latin text, as printed in Felix Liebermann's Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, with Liebermann's German translation and a literal English rendering of his German. Other MS variants, editions and translations are provided where available.
Every clause is indexed by subject, so the laws can be searched by the people, offences, places and topics they deal with.

div.head: A dictionary of early English law
div.p: The eLiebermann Legal Dictionary is a digital edition of the Wörterbuch, the dictionary in Volume II of Felix Liebermann's Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen. Liebermann's dictionary covers the Old English, Latin and French words of the law codes and certain related texts. This digital version links to the law-code clauses in which each word appears, and to explanations and translations of Liebermann's abbreviations and sigla.
